{{Quote|Name's Deera Ulyette, Senate Special Liaison to the Hutt Cartel. I work with Hutts who are friendly to the Republic. Yes, they do exist.|Deera Ulyette|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Senate Special Liaison to the Hutt Cartel''' was a position held by [[Deera Ulyette]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Ulyette was responsible for overseeing the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic's]] relationship with the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], which was officially allied with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] at the time.
